text:
Priya (CS): Quick sync — LumenHealth requested a 90m Dedicated enablement: hands-on lab + runbook review + Q&A. Two proposals: Tue Apr 4 9:00am PT or Thu Apr 6 1:00pm PT. Leaning to Apr 4. Need confirmations from @jonah, @omar, @tara_cs. Ryan, can you prep the lab repo?

Jonah (eng-runtime): I can do Apr 4 morning. Might need to duck out ~45m in to handle a support handoff but can cover the migration checklist + rollback demo.

Omar (Solutions): Apr 6 is safer for me because of a release on Apr 4. If we commit to Apr 4 I can join late (~9:30am PT) and cover the latter half. Is that ok?

Tara_cs: Either date works for facilitation. I'll assemble kickoff slides and manage the live poll at the end. Priya, can you own meeting notes?

Priya (CS): Yep I'll take notes and run the post-workshop survey. Ryan, request: include a short preflight checklist that customers can run before the lab.

Ryan_devex: Will do. I'll publish a lab notebook + preflight-checklist.md in the customer repo and link it in the invite. ETA Mon EOD. Placeholder: https://redwood.internal/lumenhealth/labs

Priya (CS): Draft agenda: ```
1) 10m intros & goals
2) 20m migration runbook + rollback strategy
3) 35m guided lab: deploy to Dedicated (hands-on)
4) 15m observability & console walkthrough
5) 10m wrap, feedback & next steps
```

Jonah (eng-runtime): I'll bring a simple fallback variant demo and a logs snippet. Example command we'll show: ```
redwood deploy --target dedicated --model rdx-tuned-v2 --fallback rdx-lite-v1
```

Maria (CS Manager): Heads up: account flagged as medium renewal risk after last QBR (delivery delays). This session is priority. Please ensure we collect CSAT and note any outstanding blockers for escalation.

Omar (Solutions): Noted. We'll validate at least one fallback model and a quick failover path before the workshop.

Priya (CS): Customer action items: please share 3 representative prompts and a small sample dataset + list of SRE contacts and allowed IP ranges. Can you send those by Monday EOD?

Customer (LumenHealth PO): We'll send prompts and a sanitized dataset by Mon EOD. Also include a couple of example traffic patterns we want to mimic.

Ryan_devex: For the lab I added optional exercises: token-budget checks, KV-cache warm start, and a lightweight quantization sanity check. Will mark them optional for customers who want deep dives.

Tara_cs: Also drafting a 3-question feedback form we can run at the end: 1) Confidence to run migration (1-5), 2) Clarity of runbook (free text), 3) Any blockers needing exec attention (checkbox). Priya, can you capture results in Gainsight?

Priya (CS): Yes I'll log the survey results in Gainsight and summarize action items.

Calendar-bot: Proposed event created: "LumenHealth Dedicated Enablement" Tue Apr 4 09:00am PT (90m). RSVP: https://calendar.company/e/efgh5678

Omar (Solutions): I'm good with Apr 4 if Jonah covers the first half and I join by 9:30 —:+1:

Jonah (eng-runtime): Fine with that plan. If I drop early, Omar will take the lab handoff.

Priya (CS): Final checklist before session: slides (Tara), lab notebook & preflight (Ryan), runbook + rollback demo (Jonah), example prompts/dataset (Customer), invite & calendar (done), post-workshop survey (Priya). Anything else?

Maria (CS Manager): Add: flag renewal notes and any unresolved blockers for an exec follow-up. I'll add a Gainsight entry after the survey.

Priya (CS): Locking on Tue Apr 4 9:00am PT. I'll circulate final agenda + pre-reads on Monday morning. Thanks team! :rocket:

Tara_cs: :thumbsup:

Customer (LumenHealth PO): Thanks — we'll get the materials to you by Mon. Looking forward to the hands-on lab.
